newsitem.title: JAPAN: Nakamichi to allocate shares to HK Grande.
newsitem.headline: Nakamichi to allocate shares to HK Grande.

text.p: Japanese audio equipment maker Nakamichi Corp said it would allocate 64 million new shares to a Singapore unit of Hong Kong's Grande Holdings Ltd in January.

The Japanese business daily Nihon Keizai Shimbun said over the weekend that Nakamichi would become a member of the Grande group as a result of the issue because the latter would own a 70.3 percent stake in Nakamichi.
Nakamichi said it would use 31.9 billion of the 35.2 billion yen it would receive from the share issue to buy an electronics parts subsidiary belonging to Grande.
Nakamichi has been suffering from poor business and is trying to diversify into the electronics and information-related businesses, the paper said.
